meta.note: Phase 2 starts in week 3, in parallel with Phase 1 rather than after it. The 302-to-404 behaviour measured on 2026-09-01 is a usable existence oracle, so the inventory is not blocked on the 404 fix — which removes roughly six weeks from the plan's original sequencing.
meta.payment_lag_note: Government payment against a certified milestone conventionally runs 30 days. Modelled as a four-week lag between billing and receipt; it is where the working capital goes.
meta.gap_note: Stage 2 cannot be procured until Stage 1 delivers the baseline that makes it costable. Twelve weeks is the planning figure for that gap: IPC's last bid ran 11 days from publication to close, but carried 180 days of bid validity, and the governance chain — Secretary, then Chairman of the Governing Body, then the Governing Body — is the long pole. Range 8 to 16 weeks. This gap is where programmes lose time, so it is drawn rather than hidden.

milestones.name: Mobilisation and inception report
milestones.exit: Team named and on site. Inception report accepted: scope, RACI, access list, and the written re-statement of the objective as adopting DBIM and the Gov.In CMS Platform rather than 'moving to india.gov.in'.
milestones.evidence: Signed inception report; access requests lodged for the Joomla database, Search Console and registry.gov.in.

milestones.name: Live site remediated
milestones.exit: A missing path returns a genuine HTTP 404 under both a browser and a bare user agent. Header charset is UTF-8 and Devanagari renders. All 389 Hindi pages declare lang="hi". CSP no longer carries a wildcard with unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval. robots.txt published. joomla.xml no longer publicly readable.
milestones.evidence: Automated assertion suite, run in front of the client, with before-and-after captures. Every item destination-independent.

milestones.name: Platform decision pack
milestones.exit: Written intake position from the MoHFW CIO, or a signed decision to take the DBIM-aligned rebuild instead. Redirect capability and destination status-code behaviour proven and documented, with the origin status-layer design if needed. Audit route settled in writing. S3WaaS ruled in or out on the record. DBIM logo lockup determined. registry.gov.in control confirmed.
milestones.evidence: Decision pack with one signed page per question, each with a named owner and a date.

milestones.name: Draft inventory: the union register
milestones.exit: One register unioning the Joomla database, a live two-signal crawl, Wayback and Common Crawl orphans, and Search Console traffic. Every URL appears exactly once, live-validated, with language tree, template and title. Hindi paired by hreflang, never by URL transformation.
milestones.evidence: Register delivered as a checked-in dataset with the crawl and validation code that produced it, so the client can re-run it.

milestones.name: Signed disposition register and redirect map
milestones.exit: Every verified URL carries a keep / archive / retire disposition signed by a named IPC content owner, including explicit dispositions for PvPI, the news archive, the legacy paths and the PDF estate. Redirect map complete: one decided row per surviving source path, with Hindi rows byte-verified through the real toolchain.
milestones.evidence: Signed CSV. Automated check that every source path resolves to exactly one row and no destination is unreachable.

milestones.name: Stage 2 cost baseline and handover
milestones.exit: Stage 2 re-costed from the delivered register rather than from estimate, with quantities, rates and a three-point spread. Operating documentation and SOPs handed over. Recurring obligations listed with named owners.
milestones.evidence: Stage 2 baseline document plus the re-runnable model. This is the deliverable that makes Stage 2 procurable.

commercial_terms.note: IPC's own revealed rate on GEM/2026/B/7781379 (13-07-2026), against a GeM recommendation of 1%. Refundable, but it blocks working capital through evaluation.
IPC's revealed rate, held 60 months on its last IT bid. For a 5.5-month assignment, negotiate the term down — a 60-month PBG on a 24-week engagement is a real and avoidable carrying cost.
Bank commission. Routinely forgotten in pricing.
Convention is 0.5% per week of delay capped at 10%. This is the schedule risk expressed in rupees.
M6 is itself 10% and is the natural retention. Do not stack a further retention on top of it.

stage2_milestones.name: Mobilisation and platform tenancy live
stage2_milestones.exit: Gov.In CMS tenancy provisioned at cms-ipc.digifootprint.gov.in with named editor accounts and roles. Stage 1's signed register loaded as the working backlog. DBIM logo lockup applied.
stage2_milestones.evidence: Tenancy reachable, roles demonstrated, register imported and row-counted against the Stage 1 sign-off.

stage2_milestones.name: Information architecture and templates approved
stage2_milestones.exit: IPC's deep Joomla trees re-expressed in the platform's flat structure and signed off. Template mapping complete across the nine source templates. CCPS banner slot reserved in the first wireframe, not retrofitted. Applications boundary decided in writing for /shop, /e-services, PvPI, iponline and onlinestore.
stage2_milestones.evidence: Approved IA document; wireframes showing the CCPS slot; a signed applications scope decision.

stage2_milestones.name: Content loaded and staging frozen
stage2_milestones.exit: Every item with a keep disposition is live on staging with alt text and heading structure present at import, not retrofitted. Hindi byte-verified through the real toolchain. WCAG 2.1 AA passes on a stratified sample covering every template plus 10% of pages. Staging frozen — GIGW 5.3.1 requires audit clearance before production hosting and the auditor must test a frozen instance.
stage2_milestones.evidence: Freeze declared in writing with a build identifier. Accessibility report against the stratified sample.

stage2_milestones.name: Audit clearance certificate issued
stage2_milestones.exit: Audit clearance certificate naming the specific frozen instance, from NIC, STQC or a CERT-In empanelled vendor. Every finding closed or formally accepted by the Web Information Manager. Zero code changes after retest — any change reopens the obligation.
stage2_milestones.evidence: The certificate itself, plus a findings register with a disposition against every row.

stage2_milestones.name: Cut-over complete and redirects asserted
stage2_milestones.exit: One A-record changed at registry.gov.in; MX records untouched and a post-cut-over mail delivery test passed. 100% of redirect rows return a 301 to a 200, asserted automatically. Retired paths return 404 or 410, never 200 — via the origin status layer if the destination still answers 200 at shallow depths. Sitemap and robots.txt published and accepted in Search Console.
stage2_milestones.evidence: Automated redirect assertion run over every row; mail test transcript; Search Console acceptance.

stage2_milestones.name: Hypercare complete and handover
stage2_milestones.exit: Four to six weeks of hypercare with the 404 log reviewed weekly and fixes applied. IGOD entry refreshed and India Portal depository records contributed. Every recurring obligation — security re-audit cadence, content review cycle, surveillance — carries a named owner and a calendar entry.
stage2_milestones.evidence: 404-log review record; IGOD entry; a signed obligations register with owners.

excluded_unpriced.note: The circulating INR 40,000 is real but its own section 6.1 scopes it to GIGW version 2009 and 87 test points. Obtain a written quote from the assigned STQC IT Laboratory, payable via Bharatkosh.

GIGW 3.0 accepts clearance from NIC, STQC or a CERT-In empanelled vendor. If NIC performs it the line is zero. If procured, no Indian government body publishes a VAPT rate card and it goes to quotation.
STQC OM F.No. STQC/IT&eGov/WQC/2022 dated 30.06.2025 makes it a pre-requisite for GIGW evaluation. Commencement language is equivocal - confirm before relying on the date.
No Indian government rate card exists. Priced per template and per sampled page, so the Phase 3 exit criterion drives it.
Official documentation states API usage shall be for proof-of-concept only. bhashini.ai is a separate commercial site and its prices are not the platform's.

excluded_unpriced.item: Gov.In CMS Platform and NIC hosting
excluded_unpriced.note: No published tariff, and no published statement that it is free. A genuine void, not a gap in searching.
Carry INR 1.00 / 2.50 / 6.00 per word. The National Translation Mission schedule of INR 0.50-1.00 is a scholar honorarium at roughly a quarter of market and will under-price a procured programme.
